chunks: They will carry their own loads and other loads besides their own; and will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they contrived.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to carry 'other loads' alongside one's own sins on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cumulative weight of sin, where the fabricators of falsehood not only carry their own transgressions but also the burdens of those misled by their lies. This concept of 'thiqal' (burdens) underscores the multiplier effect of deception in the Hereafter, as they will be questioned specifically regarding the falsehoods they invented. The verse serves as a warning that fabricated narratives create a chain of spiritual accountability extending beyond the individual.
